Wish the actual nurse corpse, then create a peaceful purple worm and scout its placement before potion throw. Material blindness variation from source: the thrown potion missed the known worm. Zap a newly wished lightning wand toward the same actual purple worm to establish its blinded flag, then use stethoscope. Monster HP is 77, so one ordinary lightning hit has room to survive; retain if the actual target remains alive and blind. Cheap source route: apply.c use_camera calls do_blinding_ray without a damaging lightning bounce; uhitm.c flash_hits_mon blinds an eyed, nonimmune purple worm. Wish an uncursed camera, apply it northeast, then inspect actual blindness with the stethoscope. The lightning wand remains unused setup inventory.
